en: Black‑and‑white winter view of a snow-covered Alpine valley. A cluster of multi‑storey hotels and spa‑like buildings sits on the valley floor, surrounded by dense coniferous forest. Behind the town rise steep, dramatic mountains with snowy peaks and ridges. The overall look is of an early or mid‑20th‑century mountain resort in winter. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.
